concerns: price below all major moving averages (EMA/SMA 9,21,50,200)
technical.summary: Strong ADX trend confirmation contradicted by pervasive bearish momentum indicators, oversold conditions without bullish confirmation, and price trapped below all key moving averages—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 28 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with only minor trades 89-103 days ago showing mixed signals (1 sale, 1 sale, 1 purchase); no news data available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (335.2) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 28 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (15/100) with strong ADX trend confirmation and stochastic bullish cross creates contrarian opportunity near support (82.59) ahead of potential capitulation reversal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish momentum (MACD, OBV, CMF, Williams %R all negative), price trapped below all major moving averages, oversold RSI without confirmation, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 335.2, strong dollar), and 28-day earnings event create unacceptable risk/reward for entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme fear sentiment and ADX trend confirmation present contrarian appeal, but pervasive bearish momentum, price below all major moving averages, and macro crisis conditions create unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (335.2), and 28-day earnings event create binary downside risk that outweighs contrarian sentiment opportunity.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate all converge on bear case; only sentiment offers contrarian counterpoint
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM position with 3 other Industrials open; sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further; skip new entry.
